create_locobot_gripper: create a LoCoBotGripper instance with configs and a custom wait time for ROS gripper control
open_gripper: open the LoCoBotGripper fully with an optional blocking wait for the action to complete
close_gripper: close the LoCoBotGripper fully with an optional blocking wait for the action to complete
reset_gripper: reset a stuck LoCoBotGripper by opening, closing, and reopening it sequentially
get_gripper_state: get the current LoCoBotGripper state returning an int from -1 to 3 indicating open, closing, object held, or closed
